integrity: Self-contained analytic recurrence, exact rational derivative sign certificates, standalone standard-library verification code; existing stability and generic Lyapunov theory are credited rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed gamma=mu NAG-GS on SPD quadratic objectives with Brownian velocity noise and Schur-stable constant time steps; not a dynamic damping, finite-time or arbitrary gradient-noise result. Specialist precedence for equivalent parameterizations is possible.
title: A sharp reentrant stationary-noise transition for semi-implicit NAG-GS
